alt: August 2025 calendar page: a watercolour of women in yellow and gold dancing joyfully in a crowd before a large Ganesha idol. Independence Day and Ganesh Chaturthi are marked.
caption: An August 2025 calendar featuring a watercolor illustration of dancers beneath the deity Ganesha.
description: A colorful watercolor rendering shows a group of people dancing with joy in a festive gathering, set against a backdrop of splashes and a serene image of an elephant-headed figure. The lower portion displays the August 2025 calendar layout, marking specific dates such as the 15th for Independence Day and the 27th for Ganesh Chaturthi.
